official_measurement_examples.name: Part Q new-dwelling scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document Q supports requirement Q1, which applies to new dwellings and requires reasonable provision to resist unauthorised access to dwellings and access routes to flats.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2015 commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government circular material records Part Q taking effect on 1 October 2015 for relevant new-dwelling building-control submissions, subject to transition for earlier submissions where work commenced before 1 October 2016.

official_measurement_examples.name: Material change of use
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2015 amendment regulations extend Q1 to new dwellings formed by specified material changes of use.

official_measurement_examples.name: FAQ update
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Approved Document Q page added a frequently asked questions document on 22 November 2024.

official_measurement_examples.name: Letter-box standard caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2024 FAQ says Approved Document Q does not explicitly set letter-box height guidance but points to referenced standards that address positioning and security.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning policy separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The March 2015 planning update said technical security standards for new homes would be covered by mandatory Part Q while planning policies on external design and layout to reduce crime remain distinct.

official_measurement_examples.name: Healthy Homes enhancement
official_measurement_examples.fact: July 2026 Healthy Homes guidance treats Part Q as the statutory minimum and Secured by Design as an additional good-practice enhancement rather than the same requirement.

official_measurement_examples.name: Existing-home replacement distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2026 Decent Homes consultation notes Part Q compliance is required for new dwellings but is not automatically required merely because doors or windows are replaced in existing homes.
